title: Industrial Nexus: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Industrial Nexus failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If production stops, check input, output, recipe, heat, power, and machine state in that order. Most factory problems are one missing constraint, not everything broken at once.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If production stalls, check the chain in order: input, recipe, power, heat, output, storage, and whether the machine is waiting on another system.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
